title: Auto Loans: vehicle age, mileage and powertrain limits by product
content:
# Auto Loans: vehicle age, mileage and powertrain limits by product

This card covers the vehicle-side entry requirements of each Auto Loans product at PCB: how old the vehicle may be, how many miles it may show, which powertrains qualify, and the extra condition some products attach to the vehicle or the applicant.

## How each limit is read

- **Vehicle age** is the current calendar year less the vehicle's model year, in whole years. The vehicle may be no older than the product's limit.
- **Mileage** is the odometer reading at application, in whole miles. It may be no higher than the product's limit.
- **Powertrain**: the powertrain types the product accepts, either a list or "any".

## Vehicle limits table

| Auto Loans product | Oldest vehicle (years) | Highest odometer reading (miles) | Eligible powertrains | Additional entry condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 10 | 125000 | any | none |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 6 | 75000 | any | the vehicle is manufacturer certified |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 10 | 125000 | any | the vehicle carries an existing lien with another lender |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 5 | 75000 | any | the lessee of the vehicle is the applicant |
| New Vehicle Loan | 1 | 5000 | any | none |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 1 | 5000 | battery electric, plug-in hybrid, hybrid | none beyond the powertrain column |

## Checklist form

For a vehicle to enter a given product, every line below must hold for that product:

1. vehicle age at most the product's oldest-vehicle limit;
2. odometer reading at most the product's mileage limit;
3. powertrain accepted by the product;
4. the product's additional entry condition, where the table shows one.

## Illustrations (hypothetical vehicles, current year taken as 2026)

| Hypothetical vehicle | Product asked for | Outcome of the vehicle tests |
|---|---|---|
| Model year 2020, 61000 miles, not manufacturer certified | Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | fails: the manufacturer-certified condition is not met (age 6 and mileage pass) |
| Model year 2025, 3200 miles, hybrid | Green Vehicle Loan | passes: age 1, mileage within 5000, hybrid is eligible |
| Model year 2025, 3200 miles, gasoline | Green Vehicle Loan | fails: the powertrain is not on the eligible list |
| Model year 2016, 118000 miles, lien held by another lender | Auto Refinance Loan | passes: age 10 equals the limit, mileage within 125000 |
